## Uniform: every port keeps the 2.1 standard

IMPLEMENTING.md's U1 to U16 and the 2.1 corpus, in every port. A port cell is ✅ only when the port is released at 2.1.0 or later (Rust: 3.2.0) and its main carries the rule with a test. On 2026-10-27 no port had reached that release; the 2.1 port wave is landing it.

## Security: the audit's findings

Every finding of medium or above in AUDIT-LEDGER.md 2026-10-27 has a row, the three highs first, then the family class, then one row of low findings per implementation. A cell is ❌ until the fix and its red-first test are on main. A ✅ that reads 'not applicable' in the source data is a column the finding does not name. Reproducer paths are the audit's, named in the source data.

## Test honesty

Tests that would go red if the code were wrong. A runner that skips an operation, a fuzzer that only checks for crashes, and a gate nobody has seen fail are claims, not measurements.

## The bar

When every cell is ✅, the family is uniform, audited, honestly tested and fast. That is the bar.

## About this page

Each row is one piece of work across the C++ reference and its fourteen ports. ✅ is done, with the test or release tag that proves it in the source data, or not applicable to that column, said in the source data. ❌ is not yet, with the reason in the source data.
